evidence: Source: https://github.com/magenta/magenta-realtime/tree/694a545e4ba0b88bf1150137b129582166d3e07f (Apache-2.0, confirmed by reading LICENSE directly because GitHub's licence API reports NOASSERTION).
Official combined model snapshot: https://huggingface.co/google/magenta-realtime-2/tree/010aa0dcb0dfd27b24f0ad07b4dad63e8f9521cc (CC-BY-4.0, ungated); includes checkpoints/mrt2_small.safetensors.
Provisioned to a Modal volume in magenta_rt's own $MAGENTA_HOME/magenta-rt-v2 layout: 12 files, asset tree 5df82db977fa20d024f1476844cdd887446c48ed41b9565603982d640af5eb52.
Checkpoint SHA256 5dd1cbc7c606c512c21de0bcb04d4818bf0a3b873d7cbb9d1556d67d3b034de3, verified against Hugging Face LFS metadata recorded before the download rather than self-computed.

Three real smoke contracts passed on an L4 in an isolated JAX CUDA runtime, retained at services/magenta-rt2-worker/release-evidence/smoke-proof.json: text (style alone, all 128 pitches masked), MIDI (C major vs A minor conditioning under one style prompt produce different dominant pitch classes), audio-context (6 s streamed render, 288000 samples, no silent seam, realtime factor 1.53).
CC-BY-4.0 attribution is attached to every realization response and every smoke proof by the worker, so an output cannot leave unattributed.
reason: Weights are provisioned, hashed and smoke-tested, and the licence permits commercial use. The model is nonetheless not routable: the plan requires a new model to beat the existing pipeline in blind evaluation before it becomes a default, and that evaluation has not been run.
blockers: No blind evaluation has compared MAGENTA_RT2 against the existing reference pipeline, so it stays SHADOW_ONLY in musicProviders.ts and cannot be selected as a default.
MAGENTA_RT2_API_URL is not configured on the API server; the worker is deployed but deliberately not wired into routing.
notRoutableBecauseNote: This is not a licence block. Reporting it as one would be false and would hide the real gate.
roleNote: Registered with capabilities [audio_generation] only. It realizes an arrangement this platform composed and is never routed as an arranger.
honestLimits: The MIDI contract's pitch classes come from a coarse FFT chroma. It shows that note conditioning changed the output; it is not a transcription and is no evidence that the realization is in tune.
Only the 230M small variant has been provisioned and run. The 2.4B base checkpoint (9.84 GB) is manifested but untested.
No musical quality judgement has been made about the output at all.
